title: SeFoRA: Sketch-Aggregated Federated Low-Rank Adaptation with Heterogeneous Client Ranks
abstract: arXiv:2608.10144v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We consider federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning of foundation models, e.g., LLMs and LVMs, using low-rank adaptation (LoRA; ~Hu et al.\ 2022). Combining LoRA with federated learning introduces challenges absent from either setting alone: clients may use different LoRA ranks, making their factor matrices dimension-incompatible, and factor-wise averaging suffers from a bilinear mismatch. We propose SeFoRA, a sketch-aggregated federated LoRA algorithm in which each client transmits a linear sketch of its local $\Delta \mathbf{W}$ updates, enabling direct aggregation at the federator. As a result, SeFoRA overcomes the rank heterogeneity challenge and alleviates the bilinear mismatch. We establish convergence to a neighborhood of a first-order stationary point at rate $\\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$. Extensive numerical experiments on language and vision models showcase the performance of our algorithm compared to existing methods.

translated_title: SeFoRA：面向异构客户端秩的草图聚合联邦低秩适配方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究基础模型（如大型语言模型 LLM 和大型视觉模型 LVM）的联邦参数高效微调问题，采用低秩适配方法。将 LoRA 与联邦学习相结合会引入两种设置各自单独都不存在的挑战：客户端可能使用不同的 LoRA 秩，导致其因子矩阵维度不兼容；同时，逐因子平均会受到双线性失配问题的困扰。我们提出了 SeFoRA，这是一种草图聚合的联邦 LoRA 算法，其中每个客户端传输其本地 ΔW 更新的线性草图，从而能够在联邦服务器端实现直接聚合。因此，SeFoRA 克服了秩异构性挑战，并缓解了双线性失配问题。我们建立了以 $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ 的速率收敛至一阶稳定点邻域的收敛性保证。在语言模型和视觉模型上开展的大量数值实验表明，我们的算法相较于现有方法具有优越的性能。
tldr: SeFoRA 通过让各客户端传输本地 ΔW 更新的线性草图实现联邦服务器端的直接聚合，解决了联邦 LoRA 中客户端秩异构导致的维度不兼容和双线性失配问题，并具有 $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ 速率的一阶稳定点邻域收敛保证。
en_tdlr: SeFoRA enables direct federated aggregation of LoRA updates by having each client transmit a linear sketch of its local ΔW, overcoming rank heterogeneity and bilinear mismatch with convergence to a neighborhood of a first-order stationary point at rate O(T^{-1/2}).
